findings.problem: Core metadata CID is not itself a binding of the actual PostgreSQL DSN. prepare loads an unverified legacy Base; worker validates only nonempty DSN. A foreign DB carrying copied original facts could yield a receipt while host fingerprints the bound original Core with no changes.
findings.bounded_fix: Prove original Base frozen bytes and Core DNS/alias closure, or reject every DSN except the exact reviewed Core host/port/database/user/no fallback and bind a sanitized target proof.

findings.problem: Docker logs CLI returns status0 while original container stderr is in subprocess.stderr; generic call drops it and execute_owner saves only stdout, losing actual helper failure.
findings.bounded_fix: Keep separate O_EXCL stdout/stderr raw logs and hashes through a dedicated owner log path; preserve generic docker stdout bytes contract.
